date_note: Date of the announcement as reported by BleepingComputer on 18 November.
exec: Anti-piracy enforcement against a large streaming service; relevant to media companies and rights holders.
plain: A large Turkish illegal TV and film streaming service has closed after an industry group reached a settlement with its operators.
summary: The Alliance for Creativity and Entertainment (ACE) announced that the Turkish illegal streaming service Dizigom is permanently shut down after a settlement with its operators. According to BleepingComputer, the sites had about 21 million monthly visits, 16 domains were transferred to ACE, and the 2023 investigation involved Turkish law enforcement and INTERPOL coordination. The domains now redirect to ACE's Watch Legally portal.
title: ACE shuts down Turkish piracy streaming service Dizigom, 21 million monthly visits
